home.title: PureCore Framework
home.subtitle: Enterprise-Grade Full-Stack Framework Built for Speed
home.description: PureCore is a high-performance, modular full-stack framework with elegant routing, automatic request validation, standardized response formatting, and built-in internationalization. Designed with developer experience at its core, it makes building robust, scalable API services simpler than ever.
home.feature_1_desc: Define groups, prefixes, and middleware through chainable calls — your route definitions are clear, concise, and self-documenting
home.feature_2_desc: A built-in automatic validation engine covers common rules out of the box, securing inputs with a single line of code
home.feature_3_desc: Frontend and backend share one set of language resources with automatic locale detection — zero configuration required
home.feature_4_desc: A unified JSON response structure with built-in pagination, error codes, and status codes ensures seamless frontend-backend collaboration
home.feature_5_desc: Complete user management, system settings, and OAuth configuration dashboard — ready to use out of the box
home.feature_6_desc: Built-in health checks, Turnstile CAPTCHA, and graceful shutdown — smooth path from development to production
home.features_subtitle: From routing to responses, from validation to i18n — redefining the full-stack experience
home.cta_subtitle: From backend APIs to frontend interfaces, PureCore delivers an efficient, all-in-one development experience. Start building your next project now.

admin.oauth_setup_github_step1: Go to GitHub Developer Settings and create a new OAuth App
admin.oauth_setup_github_step2: Set Homepage URL to your site URL
admin.oauth_setup_github_step3: Set Authorization callback URL to the recommended callback below
admin.oauth_setup_github_step4: Copy the Client ID and generate a Client Secret
admin.oauth_setup_google_step1: Go to Google Cloud Console and create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID
admin.oauth_setup_google_step2: Configure the OAuth consent screen with your app details
admin.oauth_setup_google_step3: Add the recommended callback below as an Authorized redirect URI
admin.oauth_setup_discord_step1: Go to Discord Developer Portal and create a new application
admin.oauth_setup_discord_step3: Add the recommended callback below under Redirects
admin.oauth_setup_apple_step1: Go to Apple Developer and create a Services ID
admin.oauth_setup_apple_step2: Enable Sign in with Apple on the Services ID and configure the callback domain
admin.oauth_setup_apple_step3: Go to Keys to create a private key and download the .p8 file
admin.oauth_setup_apple_step5: Fill in Services ID (as Client ID), Team ID, Key ID, and Private Key
admin.oauth_apple_no_client_secret: Apple does not use a traditional Client Secret. The system auto-generates a JWT client secret from your private key (.p8).
admin.oauth_setup_telegram_step1: Contact @BotFather on Telegram to create a bot
admin.oauth_setup_telegram_step2: Use the /newbot command to create a bot and set its username
admin.oauth_setup_telegram_step4: Use the /setdomain command to set your site URL as the bot domain
admin.oauth_setup_telegram_step5: Fill in the Bot Token, Bot Username, and callback URL
admin.oauth_telegram_note: Telegram uses a login widget, not OAuth2. It does not provide user email, so auto-registration is disabled — users must bind manually.
